title: Glossier You Rêve Eau de Parfum Travel Spray

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Travel Size & Mini Cologne > Men > Fragrance

descriptionHtml:
✓ Unisex/Genderless Scent✓ Warm & Spicy Scent✓ Layerable Scent
Fragrance Family: Warm & Spicy

Scent Type: Warm & Sweet Gourmands

Key Notes: Buttercream, Plum Butter, Ambrox

Fragrance Description: Glossier You Rêve is a lush, sweet gourmand that opens with rich buttercream, followed by an addictive center of plum butter, toasted almond, iris, and creamy white sandalwood—heightened by a warm, musky base driven by ambrox.

About the Bottle: The bottle is an objet d’art in its own right. It is crafted in house at Glossier; it has the real thumbprint indent of the designer. So just like the scent, the bottle of Glossier You Rêve is unfinished. It needs you to hold it to complete it.

About the Fragrance: Impressions of You are not scents you wear
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Spray scent as desired on your pulse points: your neck, behind your ears, your wrists, and more.
-Allow fragrance to settle for a few moments rather than rubbing it in as this can disrupt the scent.
-Apply post-shower and after moisturizing to aid absorption for a longer, stronger scent impact.
Ingredients+
Alcohol Denat., Fragrance/Parfum, Water/Aqua/Eau, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Benzyl Salicylate, Santalol, Trimethylcyclopentenyl Methylisopentenol, Hexadecanolactone, Juniperus Virginiana Oil, Farnesol, Vanillin, Benzaldehyde, Linalool, Coumarin.
